name: Новости

findings.fix: Coalesce identical reads across tab task cancellation; debounce nonempty search 300ms; update detail flags locally instead of re-reading feed per interaction; reload on actual visibility/content changes.

Reload edited item by exact ID instead of replacing shared model with first page; preserve source name + URL and original author; apply explicit edited region without inventing a region for national articles.
Enforce optional field and schedule limits in publish, freeze fields and close while saving, confirm discard of unsaved edit, use actual home-card preview.
Inject matching organization repository through detail, related news and editor; blocked accounts retain read/share but cannot like/save/report/block/comment; guest gates retained.
Primary body text, readable dark empty-list actions, capped symbols inside 44pt controls, avatar/send symbols fit at AX size, centered deletion alerts.
Parallel independent detail reads; read and cache only follow markers for subscribed feed; recommendations cached per content revision.
Keep confirmed totals above 100 when realtime snapshot is bounded to the latest 100; avoid duplicate decrement after refresh.

evidence.baseline: build/block05-baseline-suites-20261024.xcresult: 30 passed, 2 failed (identical requests=2; oversized field was published). Earlier method-only selection ran zero tests and is explicitly excluded.

units.includes: Final role-disabled controls and light/dark five-tab navigation; unit/race/validation/recommendation/contrast checks

evidence.uiRoles: build/block05-access-and-discard-20261024.xcresult: 3 passed, including 8 usable roles x own/foreign menu; guest and unsaved edit flows
evidence.uiJourneys: build/block05-final-ui-20261024.xcresult: 8 passed; uk/de filters, create/translation/preview, exact edit/reopen, saved scope, dark AX comments/delete cancel, feed failure/retry/empty and system share
evidence.rules: build/block05-rules-20261024.log: 33 passed, 0 failed; topic/region/sort browse, content schemas and role matrix, region scope and comment moderation prohibitions
evidence.callable: build/block05-comments-server-20261024.log: 1 passed, 0 skipped; callable validation, persistence and independent read in emulator

productionReadback.mode: read-only, Admin API; Rules tested separately in emulator

video.sampling: 4fps overview; 360 frames sampled at 60fps over 24–30s. Reviewed loading → failure → explicit retry → content; then XCTest intentionally terminates the app.

scope: new matching feed preview and translation

publishingRoundtrip.scope: Full-field editor save → repository → independent read and UI regional save/read-back, including retained external URL. Combined with earlier final sets; repeated tests are not counted as additional coverage.

proposals.proposal: Paginate historical comments beyond the latest 100 instead of loading the entire growing discussion.
proposals.status: existing latest-100 cap remains; full historical browsing is an additional feature, not claimed implemented

proposals.proposal: Consider a server full-text index when the news archive grows. Current bounded scan explicitly offers continuation and does not claim no matches before scan ends.
proposals.status: future design proposal; no new paid service or unbounded reads introduced

roles.matrix: 8 usable roles × own/foreign news menu, plus guest gates and blocked read-only result. Not every theme/action/role Cartesian combination was executed.

scopeLimits: Physical iPhone and real user-owned news mutations were not exercised. No claim that simulator mocks prove real production writes.
System Photos picker, crop gestures and external-browser provider UI were inspected in source; their physical-device interactions remain in the device checklist.
Comment list currently streams latest 100; older-history pagination is proposed separately.
Production read-back verifies six concrete public query shapes as Admin, not all roles or every possible filter combination. Emulator tests provide separate security evidence.
